description: Lists every animation the game needs: state machines, clips per character, transitions, cutscene beats. Names which clips exist and which are missing. Produces a list, never the animation.
when_to_use: the request is 'what animations are still missing'
a character or state machine has gaps
an animation generation run needs a list to work from
avoid_when: the list already exists and the request is to produce the clips
the problem is animation code rather than missing clips
